admitted.nl: Treat each 3x3 compartment as a pixel: replicate the complete 9-shape found in the upper-left compartment as 7s into every compartment, without overwriting 9s.
Copy every 9 cell's relative position to all other compartments as color 7, preserving all original 9s.
Use all 9 positions globally as a stencil, placing 7 in every compartment while retaining 9.
Mirror the 9 stencil horizontally and vertically into all compartments as 7, leaving 9 unchanged.
Replace every zero in a compartment with 7 if its corresponding relative coordinate is occupied by a 9 in the first compartment.
